after: Step on the switch behind me. The final bridge leads to Ryuga.

name: Ryuga
intro: Dragons do not fear the dusk. They own it.
defeat: Ha! The twilight bows to you today.
after: Your wings are strong. Fly high, and never let the dusk swallow your light.

name: Morrow
intro: Welcome, challenger. I am Morrow. The departed whisper your name... and they whisper it with pity.
defeat: The spirits fall silent. How rare. How wonderful.
after: Go on. The spirits will watch your back.

name: Ferrum
intro: Ferrum. I forge steel, and steel forges me. Let's see what you're made of.
defeat: Tempered and true. You are made of strong stuff.
after: The next room belongs to Sibyl. Do not let her get inside your head.

name: Sibyl
intro: I am Sibyl. I have already seen how this battle ends. Shall we find out if I was right?
defeat: I saw it wrongly. For the first time in years... I am glad.
after: Nox waits beyond. He is gentler than he looks. Usually.

name: Nox
intro: Nox. Most challengers flinch at the dark. You don't. Good. Now let's see you shine.
defeat: There it is. The light that broke Team Eclipse.
after: The Champion is waiting. She has been waiting for someone like you.

name: Celeste
intro: Hello, {player}. I watched you on the summit. Now show me that light up close.
defeat: Brilliant... You are the brightest star I have ever faced.
after: Tessera has a new Champion.

name: Celeste
intro: Hello, {player}. I watched you on the summit. Now show me that light up close.
defeat: Brilliant... You are the brightest star I have ever faced.
after: Tessera has a new Champion.

name: Celeste
intro: Hello, {player}. I watched you on the summit. Now show me that light up close.
defeat: Brilliant... You are the brightest star I have ever faced.
after: Tessera has a new Champion.

name: Abel
intro: Route 13 just reopened and I've been waiting all week for a real opponent!
after: Victory Road has a waterfall you'll have to climb. Bring a strong swimmer.

name: Iris
intro: The highland air does wonders for my Pokémon's coats. And their tempers!
after: Milotic are said to live in the Victory Road lake. Gorgeous, aren't they?

name: Garm
intro: I trained in Dragonspire for years and never beat Ryuga. You did? Prove it!
after: Dragons sulk when they lose. Mine is sulking very loudly right now.

name: Wade
intro: Shh! The Skyfall trout are biting! ...Fine, a quick battle.
defeat: There goes my catch AND my battle.
after: Super Rod, highland river. That's where the big Gyarados hide.

name: Nell
intro: Brr! This tarn is freezing! Battle me so I can warm up!
after: There's a little island in the middle. I found a PP Max there once. Or was it a rock?

name: Hale
intro: Every challenger walks this road. Few walk back with a Championship.
defeat: You might be one of the few.
after: Rest at the lodge before Victory Road. The keeper's tea fixes everything.

name: Tov
intro: Ranger on duty! Let's see if you can handle the highland wild.
after: Victory Road is a three-floor climb. Strength and Waterfall, both. Pack accordingly.

name: Ysa
intro: I'm warming up for the Elite Four. You're my warm-up!
defeat: Okay, maybe I need a longer warm-up.
after: Morrow, the first Elite, uses Ghost-types. Pack Dark moves.

name: Bren
intro: Welcome to Victory Road! The last road. The hardest road!
defeat: Okay, maybe not that hard for you.
after: The waterfall is the only way up. Surf the lake and climb!

name: Lia
intro: This cave has turned back hundreds of trainers. Will you be number hundred-and-one?
after: If you can't climb the falls yet, you need a Pokémon that can learn Waterfall and seven Badges.

name: Goro
intro: HYAAH! Victory Road builds strong legs! And strong fists!
defeat: My fists are tired. My legs too.
after: I've climbed that waterfall barehanded. Don't try it. Use a Pokémon.

name: Ena
intro: I sensed you'd drop down that ledge. Now sense THIS!
after: The ledge is a shortcut down. Handy if you need to go back to the Center.

name: Rook
intro: You climbed the falls! Few get this far. Fewer get farther!
after: The ladder is to the west. Upstairs, boulders block the way.

name: Crag
intro: Boulders! Boulders everywhere! I love it!
defeat: I love it slightly less now.
after: Push the boulder in that gap east. Strength makes it easy.

name: Vale
intro: Pushing boulders AND battling? You're multitasking!
after: There's a breakable rock on the east wall. Treasure behind it, probably.

name: Drake
intro: My name is Drake and I train dragons. Yes, I've heard every joke!
defeat: That one was new, at least.
after: The ladder up is in the far corner of this chamber.

name: Osk
intro: I've made it to the League five times. You'll make it zero times if I win!
defeat: Six for me, one for you. Wait, that's not how it works.
after: Ferrum's Steel-types are tough. Fire and Ground moves help.

name: Rue
intro: This gallery has the prettiest crystals in all of Victory Road. Admire them later!
after: Sibyl, the third Elite, is a Psychic. Her Pokémon grow huge in the League's power spot.

name: Zed
intro: The exit is close. But I'm closer!
after: Your rival went through here an hour ago. They looked nervous.

name: Nova
intro: I'm the last real challenge before the plateau! Probably!
after: Nox, the fourth Elite, uses Dark-types. Fighting and Fairy moves shine.

name: Mara
intro: Thirty years of battling, and I still get butterflies here. Let's battle!
after: The Champion, Celeste, adapts. She'll use whichever power fits the battle.

name: Onn
intro: The crystals hum with the Prism's light again. You restored it. Now show me your strength.
defeat: A strength worthy of the light.
after: Necrozma devours light only when it is starved. Thanks to you, it will rest.

name: {rival}
intro: This is it. The last battle before the League. Everything I've got!
defeat: ...Yeah. You're the real deal. You always were.
after: Go win it all. For both of us.

name: {rival}
intro: This is it. The last battle before the League. Everything I've got!
defeat: ...Yeah. You're the real deal. You always were.
after: Go win it all. For both of us.

name: {rival}
intro: This is it. The last battle before the League. Everything I've got!
defeat: ...Yeah. You're the real deal. You always were.
after: Go win it all. For both of us.

name: Basalt
intro: The pass is steep, the air is thin, and I'm feeling feisty!
defeat: Out of breath. Out of Pokémon.
after: Summit caves glitter, but watch your step. Eclipse left crates everywhere.

name: Wyn
intro: Ryuga let you through? Then let's see if he was right!
after: Clan scouts are tracking Eclipse up to the summit. Hurry!

name: Grunt
intro: Rear guard of Team Eclipse! Nobody follows the lens!
defeat: The lens... is probably fine without me.
after: Lord Umbra's already climbing. You're too late!

name: Grunt
intro: Halt! This canyon is closed for, um, eclipse maintenance!
after: The summit caves are full of our people. Turn back while you can.

name: Cass
intro: I patrol this pass. Prove you're not with those Eclipse creeps!
after: The tarn has an islet with something shiny on it. Bring a Surfer.

name: Lune
intro: The stars are hiding. Something up there is drinking their light...
defeat: Your light is still bright, at least.
after: When the Prism Pokémon wakes, it will be hungry. Be ready.

name: Dax
intro: Last stretch before the caves. Last chance to impress me!
after: The cave mouth is just south. Good luck up there.

name: Grunt
intro: Intruder in the crystal halls! Sound the alarm! ...Fine, I'll just battle you.
after: We cleared a path to the summit with those crates. Science!

name: Grunt
intro: These crystals are worth a fortune! And they'll power the eclipse forever!
after: Admin Vesper is upstairs. She can see the future. Supposedly.

name: Grunt
intro: You again?! I saw you in Voltara! And Mt. Prism! Do you ever take a day off?
after: Lord Umbra says when the eclipse comes, nobody will ever squint again. Inspiring!

name: Hex
intro: The Umbral Lens is my masterpiece! It will drink the Prism's light like a sponge!
defeat: My calculations... did not include you.
after: Once the lens is charged, Necrozma's light belongs to Team Eclipse. Theoretically.

name: Grunt
intro: I'm guarding the pretty pool! Off-limits!
defeat: Fine. It's not even that pretty.
after: There's something on that little islet. I can't swim, so... yeah.

name: Grunt
intro: Second floor, second line of defense! I'm the line!
after: Don't wake Admin Vesper's Pokémon. They don't sleep anyway.

name: Grunt
intro: Shh! The lens is humming. Isn't it beautiful? Now go away!
after: Vesper's corridor is north. Bring something that hits Ghosts hard.

name: Mor
intro: I joined Eclipse for the free robes. I stayed for the dramatic lighting.
defeat: The lighting was not in my favor.
after: Vesper reads futures. Mine said 'loses to a kid'. Rude, but accurate.

name: Grunt
intro: Nobody gets near Admin Vesper. Nobody!
after: Fine. She's right through there. Don't say I didn't warn you.

name: Vesper
intro: I foresaw this moment, child. In every future, you fall.
defeat: This... was not in any vision.
after: Futures can change, it seems. How very inconvenient.

name: Grunt
intro: Your friend is holding the stairwell? Cute. I'm holding THIS one!
after: Admin Corvin is in a VERY bad mood. He hasn't forgotten Mt. Prism.

name: Grunt
intro: The summit is right above us. You'll never see it!
after: Corvin's waiting in the west corridor. Tell him I tried.

name: Grunt
intro: I was told to guard this dead end. Is it a dead end? I've been here for days.
after: If Lord Umbra wins, do we get overtime? Nobody tells me anything.

name: Corvin
intro: You. The light-bearer who embarrassed me on Mt. Prism. This time the darkness wins.
defeat: Again?! How is your light still this bright?
after: Go, then. Lord Umbra will extinguish you himself.

name: Umbra
intro: Look around you, child. The Prism's light is ours. Soon the sun itself will hide.
after: Light always casts a shadow. Remember that.

name: Hazel
intro: The little sprout grew up! Let's see how tall.
defeat: Goodness, you've grown into a mighty oak.
after: Every garden needs a storm now and then. Thanks for the rain!

name: Marina
intro: The tide always comes back, Champion. So do I!
defeat: Swept out to sea... and I loved every second.
after: Come back when the tide turns. It always does.

name: Volta
intro: Encore! The crowd demanded a rematch, superstar!
after: That show sold out. Literally, my wallet's empty.

name: Garnet
intro: Bedrock, eh? Let's see if you've eroded since!
defeat: Not a crack in you. Solid granite.
after: Next time I'm bringing a bigger drill.

name: Elowen
intro: The mist has missed you, little star.
defeat: Such light... the veil could never hold you.
after: Shine on. The mist will always remember you.

name: Blaise
intro: The forge is still hot, Champion. Let's reheat that rivalry!
defeat: Tempered steel! You're forged for this.
after: Ashfall's fires never go out. Neither will this rematch.

name: Isolde
intro: The ice remembers every footstep. Yours left cracks. Let's mend them.
defeat: A thaw... in the middle of winter.
after: Frostmere's snow will wait for your return.

name: Ryuga
intro: Dragons sleep long and wake hungry. So do I.
after: Dragonspire's flame burns for you now, Champion.

name: Morrow
intro: Back from the other side, are we? Splendid. So am I.
defeat: Ah... the veil parts for you once more.
after: The dead are patient. I can wait for another round.

name: Ferrum
intro: Steel doesn't rust, Champion. It hardens. Let me show you.
defeat: Bent... but never broken. Well done.
after: I'll reforge every plate of armor for next time.

name: Sibyl
intro: I foresaw this rematch the day you won. I foresaw the outcome too... perhaps.
defeat: The future is never fixed. Yours shines brightest.
after: Come again. I'll pretend to be surprised.

name: Nox
intro: Team Eclipse dreamed of endless night. I simply live in it. Shall we?
after: Night always returns. So will I.

name: Celeste
intro: The crown sits well on you. But a crown must be defended. Show me, Champion!
defeat: Radiant. Truly radiant. Tessera chose well.
after: Whenever you wish to dance again, I'll be waiting under the light.

name: {rival}
intro: Champion or not, I'm still gunning for you!
defeat: Ha... still the best. One day, {player}. One day.
after: Rematch whenever. I'll be here, training like crazy.

name: {rival}
intro: Champion or not, I'm still gunning for you!
defeat: Ha... still the best. One day, {player}. One day.
after: Rematch whenever. I'll be here, training like crazy.

name: {rival}
intro: Champion or not, I'm still gunning for you!
defeat: Ha... still the best. One day, {player}. One day.
after: Rematch whenever. I'll be here, training like crazy.

name: Mara
intro: A Champion on Route 14? Prove it!
after: The Tower Tycoon is even scarier than me. Good luck.

name: Drake
intro: The isles are where Champions come to be humbled!
after: Dragon-types are everywhere out here. Stock up on Ice moves.

name: Kai
intro: This jungle is my beat. Let's see your stuff!
after: Grass hides the rare ones. Night brings out Alolan Rattata and Meowth.

name: Tumo
intro: Whoa! You nearly stepped on my lunch!
after: That glowing den up north hums at night. I don't go near it.

name: Leilani
intro: Dance with me, Champion!
defeat: You stepped on my toes. Figuratively.
after: Oricorio change style with nectar. This one loves pink flowers!

name: Koa
intro: Hii-yah! Island karate!
after: Crabrawler climb trees to reach berries. Inspiring!

name: Ana
intro: The water's warm! Battle in it!
after: The sea between the isles is full of surprises.

name: Noe
intro: Brr! Battle me before I freeze!
after: An iceberg drifts north of here. Something big rests on it.

name: Iris
intro: Cold water keeps my mind sharp!
after: Tempest Isle is straight north. Mind the rain.

name: Finn
intro: I swim laps around Champions!
after: The crag behind me is sealed. A ranger guards it day and night.

name: Mele
intro: Surf's up! Battle's on!
after: My Eiscue's face is an ice cube. It's adorable.

name: Ulu
intro: Shh! You'll scare the fish! ...Fine, let's battle.
defeat: The fish got away AND I lost.
after: Super Rods catch Kingdra here, if you're patient.

name: Bram
intro: Ahoy! Haul anchor and battle!
after: I sail to Tempest Isle on calm days. Never seen a calm day.

name: Rhea
intro: Lightning strikes twice here. So do I!
after: The storm sage studies the legendary birds. He's odd, but kind.

name: Orin
intro: I foresaw your arrival. And my victory.
after: Lugia sleeps under this island. I can feel its dreams.

name: Tasi
intro: Rangers patrol even in this weather!
after: A beast with a thundercloud mane hunts the east meadow.

name: Hoku
intro: I train under the thunder!
after: Electric-types gather here. Bring a Ground-type!

name: Rocco
intro: This cave is MY cave! Well, Lugia's. But mine too!
after: The gale at the bottom ladder... nobody gets through.

name: Selka
intro: The wind down here whispers about you.
defeat: It's whispering about my loss now.
after: They say a Silver Wing calms the storm. Ask the sage outside.

name: Vey
intro: The guardian of the sea dreams. Don't wake it... unless you beat me.
after: Lugia's dreams taste like salt and thunder.

name: Magnus
intro: It's hot! My Pokémon are hotter!
after: Groudon sleeps in the vent. Some nights the whole isle shakes.

name: Pele
intro: Feel the heat, Champion!
defeat: I'm the one who got burned.
after: Moltres circles the summit at dawn. Use the pass in the middle.

name: Ignis
intro: Fire fists! Fire kicks! FIRE!
after: Entei runs through the ash fields like a living wildfire.

name: Ashby
intro: I'm measuring vent temperatures. And your strength!
defeat: Off the charts... the wrong way for me.
after: The shrine maiden tends the volcano. She knows the old legends of land and sea.

name: Ember
intro: Only the strong reach the summit!
after: Moltres doesn't like visitors. Bring Rock moves.

name: Basalt
intro: Rock solid, lava hot!
after: The heat comes from deeper in. From something alive.

name: Vulca
intro: My thermometer just broke. Want to break your streak?
after: Groudon's Red Orb resonates with its ancient power. The maiden keeps it.

name: Kana
intro: The reefs are my playground!
after: South of here is Eclipse Atoll. The altars there are ancient.

name: Loa
intro: Watch out for the jellyfish! ...that's my team.
after: Toxapex are a pain. Bring Psychic or Ground moves.

name: Pua
intro: Isn't my Milotic gorgeous? Let's battle!
after: Feebas are rare, but Milotic sometimes bite a Super Rod here.

name: Mako
intro: My lines are tangled! Battle while I fix them!
defeat: Now my lines AND my nerves are tangled.
after: Dragalge hide in the kelp. Super Rod!

name: Nalani
intro: This reef islet is my training ground!
after: The palm in the middle of the islet hides something.

name: Keoni
intro: Dive in!
after: Cramorant swallow whole Arrokuda. Then spit them at you!

name: Mahina
intro: Beauty is a battle, darling.
after: The Altar of the Moon glows at night. So do I.

name: Hale
intro: Land ho! Battle ho!
after: Dhelmise lurk in sunken wrecks off the atoll.

name: Luna
intro: The moon whispers of a beast with silver wings.
after: Lunala answers only to those who reach the moon altar.

name: Sol
intro: The sun blazes for the lion of dawn!
after: Solgaleo's altar is the northern shrine. It's warm inside.

name: Dawn
intro: Dawn breaks! So will your streak!
after: The warden can awaken Ultra Burst once a sun or moon legend trusts you.

name: Dusk
intro: Darkness suits me. Let's battle!
after: Team Eclipse wanted an endless night. I just like nighttime.

name: Moana
intro: The ocean calls! So do I!
after: A blue beast walks on water near the spring islet. It's beautiful.

name: Tavi
intro: Sharks! Everywhere! Battle!
after: The rocky islet has a cave. The water inside glows blue.

name: Lani
intro: My Wailord is the size of a ferry!
after: The Sky Pillar is east. Nobody's opened its doors in a century.

name: Pono
intro: Reeling in a big one! ...It's you!
after: Relicanth have lived unchanged for a hundred million years. Respect.

name: Kahu
intro: Few reach this islet. Fewer leave undefeated!
after: The Seafloor Cavern holds the Blue Orb's master.

name: Iolana
intro: Splish splash!
after: Swim west to get back to Route 15.

name: Nami
intro: I swam in here and got lost. Battle while I think!
after: The big lagoon... something huge sleeps under the surface.

name: Coral
intro: Kyogre's power fills this place. And mine!
after: Kyogre with the Blue Orb reverts to its primal state. Terrifying!

name: Ryuji
intro: Dragons guard the pillar. I guard the dragons!
after: Rayquaza descends only when sea and land have both been calmed.

name: Tia
intro: One step closer to the sky!
after: The stairs are past the maze. Follow the east wall.

name: Oro
intro: The pillar tests all who climb.
after: Rayquaza ends the quarrel of Kyogre and Groudon. So the old scrolls say.

name: Vega
intro: Only Champions get in here. Let's see if you deserve it.
after: Something in the depths is watching. It's not a friendly feeling.

name: Altair
intro: This grotto is the final test of strength!
after: The Pokémon below was created, not born. Be careful.

name: Jasper
intro: Welcome to the Tower! I'm your warm-up.

name: Opal
intro: Let's make this quick and sparkly!

name: Daichi
intro: Fists of the Tower!

name: Seren
intro: I already know how this ends. Do you?

name: Winston
intro: A gentleman never refuses a duel.

name: Amaryllis
intro: Battle me beautifully.

name: Ronan
intro: Round four. The real Tower starts now.

name: Sabine
intro: I've reached round seven a hundred times. You won't get past me.
defeat: Make that a hundred and one... for you.

name: Thorne
intro: The wild taught me strategy. Let me teach you.

name: Dr. Kepler
intro: My calculations give you a 12% chance. Let's test that.

name: Ishida
intro: Discipline. Focus. Victory.

name: Mirielle
intro: Your streak ends in my dreams. Shall we make it real?

name: Kaito
intro: Round seven. Every challenger meets me sooner or later.

name: Astrid
intro: Seven battles, one ace. That's me.

name: Rafael
intro: One more win and the Tower honors you. If.

name: Aurelio
intro: Twenty victories without a fall. Then you've earned an audience with me. I am the Tycoon. Show me the meaning of a streak!
defeat: Magnificent! The Tower has a new legend.
after: Come back and climb again. I'll be waiting at the top.

name: Lucy
intro: I caught this one in the dark! Wanna see?
after: Hoothoot only come out at night. They're sleepy in the day, just like me.

name: Sam
intro: Hey! You're not from around here. Battle!
defeat: Lillipup, we'll get them next time!
after: Lillipup's nose is amazing. It found my lost shoe yesterday!

name: Pip
intro: My Bidoof and I are going to be famous! Battle me!

name: Pip
intro: I've been training every single day! Let's go!

name: Pip
intro: Remember me? Bibarel's teeth are sharper than ever!
defeat: You keep getting stronger too. Not fair!

name: Pip
intro: This time for sure! My team's in the top percentage of ALL teams!
defeat: Haha... I knew it. You're a legend.

name: Nora
intro: My Nidoran picked a fight with your shoes. Battle!
defeat: Ouch! Pricked by my own pride.
after: Nidoran's horn has poison in it. Carry Antidotes on Route 2!

name: Kip
intro: I've got three bugs in my net! Want to see them all?
defeat: My net has a hole in it...
after: Ledyba come out in the morning, Spinarak at night. Kricketot sing all evening.

name: Remy
intro: Shh! I'm waiting for Scatterbug to wrap itself up!
defeat: You scared it into evolving! Thanks?
after: Scatterbug's wing patterns change depending on where it grows up.

name: Hana
intro: The flowers in this forest grow sweeter than anywhere! Let me show you why.
after: Cutiefly can sense the aura of flowers. It always finds the best ones.

name: Jay
intro: There's a secret path east of here. I'm guarding it! Kinda.
defeat: Okay, okay, go see for yourself.
after: That path leads to Mossgrove Thicket. The bugs there are even bigger!

name: Reed
intro: Shh! You'll scare the fish! ...Fine. Let's battle instead.
after: The brook runs cold and clear. Poliwag love it. So do I.

name: Petra
intro: I come here to watch the birds. You're not a bird! Battle!
after: Taillow are tiny, but they're brave enough to take on anything.

name: Dino
intro: My Zigzagoon found this trail! Now it's OUR trail!
defeat: Zigzagoon zigged when it should've zagged...
after: Zigzagoon walk in zigzags and find stuff on the ground. Look around carefully!

name: Nils
intro: Surskit skate on water! Isn't that the coolest?
after: Surskit skims along the brook when it rains. Wurmple just sits there.

name: Ivy
intro: These berries are mine! ...Oh, you're just passing? Battle anyway!
after: Cherubi store their nutrients in the little berry on their head.

name: Cole
intro: I patrol Mossgrove. Let's see if you treat the forest with respect!
after: The mossy stones are older than Brindle City. Light them both and the thicket opens up.

name: Arlo
intro: I've caught every bug in Mossgrove! Well, almost.
defeat: I should catch some stronger ones.
after: Burmy dress themselves in leaves here. In a cave they'd wear sand!

name: Wren
intro: Spiders and grasshoppers! My two favorite things!
after: Tarountula spin a ball of thread. Nymble just kick things.

name: Bo
intro: I got lost in here two days ago. Let's battle while I figure it out!
after: Those ledges only go one way. I keep ending up back down here!

name: Tomas
intro: At night these two light up the whole thicket!
after: Volbeat and Illumise dance together. It's like a light show!

name: Doyle
intro: Roots, rocks and Pokémon! What more could a hiker want?
after: The carvings down here look like the ones in the Lumen Ruins. Who made them?

name: Lena
intro: I sensed you coming from the glade above.
after: The stones down here hum with old energy. Step on them and listen.

name: Ike
intro: The mushrooms down here glow at night! And so do my bugs!
after: Foongus look just like Poké Balls. I've grabbed the wrong one twice!

name: Mort
intro: HELLO! ...HELLo... hello... Ha! Listen to that echo!
after: Whismur cry like crazy when they hear an echo. This cave is their heaven.

name: Rose
intro: Isn't this meadow lovely? Let's battle among the flowers!
defeat: You trampled my daisies... and my team.
after: Flabébé each pick one flower and carry it forever. Mine chose a white one.

name: Dale
intro: Combee! Swarm formation!
defeat: They flew back to the hive...
after: Only female Combee evolve. I've been checking every one I catch!

name: Tess
intro: I'm having a picnic with my Pokémon! You can join if you win!
defeat: Okay, you can have a sandwich.
after: Lechonk eat everything in the picnic basket. EVERYTHING.

name: Hal
intro: I'm training for the Brindle Gym. You look like good practice!
defeat: Maybe I need more practice first...
after: Hazel uses Grass types. Pidgey's Gust really helped me. Or it would have, if I'd won.

name: Otto
intro: This pond's my secret spot! How'd you find it? Battle!
defeat: My secret's out... and so am I.
after: Lotad drift around here like lily pads. A Good Rod hooks bigger fish.

name: Lily
intro: I come to Petal Path to pick flowers for my hair. Want to battle?
after: The berry grower in the cottage up north is so generous. Say hi to him!

name: Toru
intro: The tower sways, but the sages do not. Show me your balance!
after: This tower is built around one great pillar. In storms the whole tower bends like grass.

name: Gaku
intro: Every step up this tower is a step toward the light. Battle!
after: Natu stare at the sun all day. They say Natu can see the future in it.

name: Masa
intro: Hoothoot keep watch over the tower by night. And I by day!
after: Elder Rowan waits at the top. He has tested every Brindle Gym Leader since Hazel's grandmother.

name: Edmund
intro: Before you meet the Elder, you must pass me!
after: The lantern has been empty for a hundred years. Still, we light candles every night.

name: Elder Rowan
intro: Let us see whether your bond with your Pokémon bends without breaking.
defeat: Ho ho! You bend like grass in the wind, and stand back up.

name: Nate
intro: Fish love the cold water under the falls! I love fish! Battle!
after: The falls come all the way down from the foothills of Mt. Prism. Imagine where the water's been!

name: Erin
intro: The mist from the falls makes my hair frizzy. Let's battle to forget!
after: Azurill bounce around on their tails near the water. So cute!

name: Leo
intro: Surskit skate on the pools up here! Watch mine skate circles around you!
after: If you train Surskit, it grows into Masquerain. Scary eyes on its wings!

name: Tobias
intro: I hiked all the way up from Hollowbrook! My legs are tired but my Pokémon aren't!
after: Going back is easier. Hop down the ledges and follow the brook!

name: Wes
intro: One day I'll climb to the top of those falls! Practice battle first!
after: You need a special move to climb waterfalls. Not just strong legs.

name: Fay
intro: I found this glade by following the green light! Isn't it magical?
after: The Moss Rock is warm, even at night. Eevee would love it here.

name: Holt
intro: Few trainers make it past the mossy stones. Let's see what you're made of!
after: There's a hollow stump to the north. It leads down into the roots. Bring an Escape Rope.

name: Moss
intro: My mom named me after this cave! Okay, not really. Battle!
after: Paras grow mushrooms on their backs. The mushrooms down here are probably from Paras!

name: Wendy
intro: I'm on my way to the orchard! But first, a battle!
defeat: My picnic basket is empty AND I lost?
after: There's a skinny tree north of here. Behind it is the Sunberry Orchard. With Cut you can get in!

name: Lex
intro: Doduo and I run laps on Route 3 every day! Keep up!
after: Doduo's two heads never agree on which way to run. That's why we're so slow.

name: Greta
intro: Aren't my babies adorable? Battle us and see!
after: Phanpy love a mud bath. They come back so happy and so filthy.

name: Koji
intro: Hyah! I train by punching the ridge! Want to see?
defeat: My knuckles hurt more than my pride.
after: Machop and Makuhita both learn Rock Smash. The Tide Badge lets you use it outside battle!

name: Teo
intro: Rocks don't move, but they hit hard! Let me show you!

name: Teo
intro: I've been climbing every mountain in Tessera! My team is solid now!

name: Teo
intro: Remember Teo? My Onix found a Metal Coat in a cave! Look at it now!

name: Teo
intro: Seven badges! Then let's see who's the real mountain here!
defeat: You ARE the mountain. I'm just a pebble.

name: Cherry
intro: I'm picking berries for a pie! Battle me while they ripen!
after: Bounsweet smell so sweet that wild Pokémon try to nibble them.

name: Ned
intro: The bugs in this orchard are huge! They eat SO many berries!
after: The keeper doesn't mind the bugs. He says they help the flowers turn into berries.

name: Milo
intro: Applin live inside apples! Isn't that the cutest thing?
after: I've heard an Applin hiding in the Mossgrove Glade, west of Brindle. That's where I found mine.

name: Rob
intro: I'm guarding the berries from Skwovet! You're not a Skwovet, are you?
after: Skwovet stuff their cheeks with berries. Greedent are even greedier.

name: Celia
intro: The orchard air is good for the skin. And for battling!
after: The keeper's wife makes the best berry tea. She'll heal your Pokémon if you ask.

name: Lou
intro: Fish bite better when berries fall in the pond! Battle while I wait?
defeat: The one that got away... was me.
after: Barboach and Chewtle live in this pond. You'll need a Good Rod for them.

name: Wren
intro: I come up here to watch the sea birds. And to battle!
after: Wattrel ride the sea wind under the cliffs. They zap anything that gets close.

name: Gale
intro: Arr! This beach is where I learned to swim! Battle me, landlubber!
after: There's a sea cave up the beach, tucked behind the rocks. The tide hides it in the morning.

name: Nami
intro: I just came out of the water. Let's battle before I dry off!
after: Skrelp drift in the kelp near the cape. They look like seaweed until they squirt you.

name: Bo
intro: The cape's the best fishing spot in Tessera. Fight me for it!
after: With a Good Rod, Clamperl bite off this beach. Some even hold pearls!

name: Nico
intro: I'm going to climb the lighthouse! But first, I'll beat you!
defeat: Maybe I'll just look at it from here.
after: The lighthouse lamp didn't shine last night. The keeper seems worried.

name: Odette
intro: The sea breeze up here is lovely. Shall we battle?
after: On clear days you can see the Coral Isles from the lighthouse gallery. Or so they say.

name: Brock
intro: No one gets up the lighthouse without beating an old salt like me!
after: The keeper's upstairs, fretting about his key. Go see him.

name: Ward
intro: I visit every lighthouse in Tessera. This one is my favorite. Shall we?
after: A lighthouse without a lamp is just a very tall house.

name: Mira
intro: My grandpa is the keeper! Battle me and I'll introduce you!
defeat: Grandpa would be proud of you, not me.
after: A Wingull snatched Grandpa's key and flew off toward the beach. Wingull love shiny things!

name: Rocco
intro: Down this deep, the rocks sing! Can you hear them?
defeat: That's not singing. That's my ears ringing.
after: Miners dug these tunnels long ago. The old vault in the south is still sealed, they say.

name: Jun
intro: I meditate by the underground lake. You disturbed my peace! Battle!
after: There's a glowing stone in the far corner. I didn't dare step on it.

name: Ora
intro: The stones down here remember the miners. I can hear them whisper.
after: Two stones, two doors. The miners were very fond of pairs.

name: Dunn
intro: These rocks are hot to the touch! Something's alive in them!
after: Sizzlipede curl up in the warm cracks. Rolycoly roll around and make sparks.

name: Haru
intro: Students of the Riptide fight like the tide: relentless! Hyah!
after: Master Kaito learned to fight on the decks of fishing boats. Balance is everything!

name: Fitz
intro: I joined the dojo to toughen up for storm season! Let's go!
after: A real sailor can tie forty knots and throw a punch at the same time.

name: Sora
intro: My fists are faster than a Buizel! Can you keep up?
after: Clobbopus from the bay hit like little hammers. The Master trains with them.

name: Nash
intro: Before you face the Master, you face the Riptide's last wave: me!
after: Go on, the Master's been watching you. He's grinning. That's either good or very bad.

name: Master Kaito
intro: The sea teaches patience, then strikes without warning. So do I!
defeat: Ha! You ride the waves well.

name: Lyle
intro: I map every tunnel in Cobblecrest! This one's mine!
defeat: I'll add you to the map. As a hazard.
after: There's a ladder on B1F that goes even deeper now. Miners must have dug it out again.

name: Noor
intro: I came down here to escape the noise of the port. Now you're here.
defeat: So much for peace and quiet.
after: The deeper you go in Cobblecrest, the quieter it gets. Except for the Noibat.

name: Quill
intro: I served on this ship before she ran aground! Nobody loots her on my watch!
after: She was carrying crates of glowing stones from the islands when the storm hit.

name: Hale
intro: I came looking for my lost luggage. Fifteen years late, admittedly.
defeat: My luggage is still lost, and now so is the battle.
after: First class used to be up here. Now it's mostly barnacles.

name: Morgan
intro: Har! A stowaway! Prepare to battle!
after: The captain's log is still on the wall. Spooky reading.

name: Esme
intro: The spirits of this ship are restless... Can you feel them?
after: Shuppet feed on grudges. This ship has plenty. The captain never forgave that storm.

name: Crane
intro: Something moved in the dark down here! Was it you? BATTLE!
after: I keep hearing giggling from behind the crates. Must be the wind. Must be.

name: Pike
intro: The hold flooded, so I fish in it! Smart, eh?
after: Caught a Shellder in here once. Must have washed in with the tide.

name: Clint
intro: Nincada dig under Route 3! I dug up mine with my own hands!
defeat: I'll go dig a hole and hide in it.
after: If you train Nincada, sometimes you get a bonus Pokémon when it evolves. Spooky!

name: Ivette
intro: I'm flying a kite! Well, Wingull is. Want to battle while it's up there?
after: The sea wind up here can lift a Swablu clear over the lighthouse.

name: Pipkin
intro: Grandpa says I can't eat berries until I win a battle!
after: Grandpa runs the orchard. Grandma makes tea that fixes everything!

name: Lars
intro: I swam in through an underwater tunnel! Don't tell my mom!
defeat: I'll swim home and think about this.
after: Wingull nest up on the ledges in here. They steal anything shiny.

name: Reef
intro: Sea caves are the best caves! Salt, rocks and Krabby!
after: The tide fills half this cave at night. Explore it while you can!

name: Dax
intro: I climbed down the new ladder! I'm the first one here! ...Right?
after: The old miner by the lake knows everything about this place.

name: Tom
intro: I'm counting the stairs in the lighthouse! Battle me so I don't lose count!
defeat: Now I've lost count. And the battle.
after: One hundred and twelve steps. Or so. Probably.

name: Maya
intro: I came over the ridge just to battle at Port Tidewater. You'll be my warm-up!
after: Marina's Water types are fast. Grass and Electric moves are your best friends there.

name: Basil
intro: I buy the orchard's finest fruit every season. Shall we have a refined battle?
defeat: Most unrefined of me to lose.
after: Leftovers from this orchard? A trainer's secret weapon, they say. Ask the keeper.

name: Ada
intro: A picnic by the sea! Care to battle for the last sandwich?
after: Lumen Village is just south. The ruins there are older than anyone remembers.

name: Milo
intro: I'm gonna catch a Ponyta and ride it home! But first, you!
defeat: Ponyta wouldn't let me ride it anyway...
after: Herdier can smell trainers from way down the road. That's how I found you!

name: Gord
intro: There's a cave up north that sparkles in the dark! I'm its guardian. Self-appointed.
after: Glimmer Cave is pitch black without Flash. The sage in Whisperwood handed out that TM, I hear.

name: Lena
intro: I'm warming up for Volta's gym. You'll do nicely!
defeat: I need a Ground type. Badly.
after: Volta's Electric types hit hard, but Ground-type Pokémon don't feel a thing.

name: Dot
intro: My Pokémon are the zappiest on Route 6! Let's battle!

name: Dot
intro: I've been charging up since our last battle! Ready?

name: Dot
intro: Six badges? Then I'm turning the voltage all the way up!

name: Dot
intro: Eight badges! This is the brightest battle of my life!

name: Basil
intro: Who goes there? Oh, a trainer! Thought you were a Zubat.
after: The crystals in here store sunlight and glow for days. Nobody knows why.

name: Vera
intro: The crystals sing in the dark. I came to listen. You came to battle.
after: Team Eclipse were snooping around Lumen. They'd love crystals that hold light.

name: Ohm
intro: I'm measuring the cave's charge! Your Pokémon will make great test subjects!
defeat: My readings are off the charts!
after: The engineer up at Solar Ridge lost a part down here. He's been moping for days.

name: Flint
intro: I crack rocks for a living! Watch this!
after: Some rocks in here are cracked. A Pokémon with Rock Smash can break right through.

name: Ryo
intro: I train in total darkness to sharpen my senses! Hyah!
after: Without Flash, every step here is a guess. With it, everything glitters.

name: Quinn
intro: Deeper means shinier! And tougher!
after: There's a crystal pool in the middle of this floor. Something glitters on the islet.

name: Amp
intro: These crystals could power Voltara for a year! If they didn't explode.
after: Team Eclipse siphoned the power plant, but crystals like these? Even worse in the wrong hands.

name: Luna
intro: I sense a strong will. And a strong Pokémon. Show me.
after: The deepest crystal vein is just behind me. I've been guarding it from Sableye.

name: Sol
intro: The old people of Lumen worshipped the sun's path. Can you follow it?
after: Dawn rises in the east. Noon stands high. Dusk falls west. Night lies below.

name: Rin
intro: These halls are sacred. Prove your heart is honest!
after: If the stones go dark, you've walked the day out of order. Start again from dawn.

name: Tao
intro: Unown everywhere! They spell words, you know. Let me show you my data!
after: The carvings down here match the murals above. And the ones in a cave near Whisperwood!

name: Volt
intro: These panels feed Voltara when the plant is down. Don't touch them! Battle me instead.
after: Solar power doesn't care about Team Eclipse. The sun always comes back.

name: Dex
intro: The view from the ridge is great. The battles are better!
after: From up here you can see Mt. Prism glitter at sunset.

name: Crag
intro: Up here the wind never stops! Neither do I!
after: There's a cracked rock in the cliff face north of the panels. Something sparkles behind it.

name: Juno
intro: I'm picking flowers for my Plusle and Minun! Battle?
defeat: They're cheering for you now. Traitors.
after: Plusle and Minun cheer each other on. They live all over the ridge.

name: Pete
intro: My Yamper loves running in the wind! Let's go!
after: Yamper make electricity when they run. They power the whole station on a good day. Not really.

name: Selene
intro: The sunset up here is breathtaking. So is my team!
after: Mareep wool builds up static. Brush one and your hair stands on end!

name: Watt
intro: The reservoir's full of fish! And Chinchou, somehow.
after: Chinchou glow at the bottom of the reservoir at night. Spooky but pretty.

name: Dylan
intro: I swim here every morning! The water's perfect. So is my team!
after: Once you can Surf, swim out past the cove. The current carries you along the coast.

name: Coral
intro: Sun, sand and a battle! What a day!
defeat: Time for a nap in the sun.
after: Sandygast are made of sand. Kids build sandcastles and sometimes they just... walk away.

name: Merle
intro: The tide pools are full of surprises! So am I!
after: Corphish snap at anything in the tide pools. Good Rod's the way to go.

name: Barney
intro: I'm on shore leave and I'm itching for a fight! Har!
defeat: Back to the ship with me.
after: The Coral Isles? Only the ferry goes there. Champions only, they say.

name: Shelly
intro: I collect pretty shells. And pretty victories!
after: The gentleman in the hut buys Big Pearls. He pays in something much shinier.

name: Robin
intro: I found a Dwebble in my sandcastle! Wanna see it fight?
after: Dwebble carry rocks as houses. Mine keeps trying to move into my bucket.

name: Cobb
intro: The marsh pools hum when the power lines buzz. The fish love it!
after: Chinchou somehow found their way into these pools. Must be the electricity.

name: Gnat
intro: Marsh bugs are the toughest bugs! Muddy and mean!
after: Surskit skate here in spring. In summer they grow into Masquerain and fly off.

name: Ola
intro: Look at my muddy babies! Aren't they precious?
defeat: Oh no, they need a bath now.
after: Wooper here are brown instead of blue! Paldean Wooper, they call them. Poison type, too!

name: Eel
intro: I study how the power lines affect marsh Pokémon! Let me collect some data from you!
after: Tynamo float in the shallows at night, glowing like little lanterns.

name: Wade
intro: My boots are full of mud but my heart is full of fire! Battle!
defeat: My boots are full of defeat.
after: Croagunk puff up their cheeks and croak at sunset. It's like a concert, but worse.

name: Hugo
intro: My Ponyta's mane is the shiniest on Route 5! Battle and see!
defeat: Its mane is still shiny. My pride, less so.
after: Ponyta only let you ride them if they trust you. Mine still doesn't.

name: Umi
intro: I keep watch over the east wing. Only the worthy pass!
after: Each stone holds one part of the day. Light them as the sun travels.

name: Taro
intro: I punch crystals to train! They punch back sometimes!
after: The cracked rock behind me hides something the engineer would want.

name: Orin
intro: I came to meditate among the crystals. Your light disturbs me!
defeat: Perhaps light is not so bad.
after: The ladder behind me leads down to the deepest crystals.

name: Sunny
intro: I'm helping Grandpa clean the solar panels! Battle break!
after: Plusle and Minun love the panels. They nap on them when it's sunny.

name: Wally
intro: The cove's tide pools are packed today! Fight me for the best spot!
after: Staryu wash up at low tide. They glow like little stars on the sand.

name: Reed
intro: I'm not lost! I'm... exploring the marsh! Battle!
after: Stunfisk lie flat in the mud. I've stepped on three today. They were not happy.

name: Tilly
intro: The pylons make my hair stand on end! Yours too? Let's battle!
after: Pachirisu stores static in its cheeks. Don't pet it in a thunderstorm.

name: Dex
intro: Rangers keep these foothills safe. Let me check you're not a troublemaker!
defeat: You're trouble, all right. For me.
after: There's an old mine above Quarrytown. Folks say lamps still flicker down there.

name: Ulric
intro: This canyon's got cracks you could walk right into! Ha! Battle first!
after: That crack in the west wall? It opens into a whole hidden gulch. Fossil hunters camp in there.

name: Juno
intro: Three types, zero weaknesses I can't cover. Ready?
after: Garnet's Rock types can't stand Grass or Water. I built my whole team around that.

name: Dale
intro: Guild says this shaft's closed. I say a closed shaft is a quiet place to train!
after: The No. 3 crew dug deep before the collapse. Their old ladders still hold. Mostly.

name: Tamsin
intro: My friends dared me to come in here! You're not a ghost, are you?
defeat: Okay, ghosts don't battle that well.
after: My friends ran off when we heard a pickaxe tapping below. Nobody's down there... right?

name: Ostin
intro: Shh! I'm listening to the rock. It says you want to battle.
after: Strength moves boulders, Rock Smash breaks the cracked ones. A miner's two best friends.

name: Gil
intro: Gurdurr and I carry beams all day. You're lighter than a beam!
defeat: I should've lifted with my legs.
after: We're shoring up the old tunnels for the Guild. Slow work. Wild Timburr keep stealing our planks.

name: Hal
intro: It's pitch black down here. Good thing my Klawf can see in the dark. Can yours?
after: Use Flash down here, or you'll bump into every boulder twice.

name: Pell
intro: The lower galleries flooded when the shaft collapsed. Isn't that romantic?
after: Push the boulders through the gaps. That's how the crew blocked off the vault, and how you get in.

name: Corra
intro: Did you see the glowing mushrooms? Mine glow brighter!
after: Shiinotic glow in the dark. They make the scariest tunnels feel cozy.

name: Nils
intro: Fishing in a mine! The Whiscash down here have never seen a lure!
after: Can't reach the little island without Surf. Something shiny's out there, though.

name: Rudd
intro: The vault is MINE! I've been digging here for a year! ...Fine, battle me for it.
defeat: A year of digging, buried in a minute.
after: Take one fossil, leave the other. That's the old miners' rule. Greed caused the collapse, they say.

name: Bram
intro: Deepest gallery in Quarrytown! Feel that? That's the mountain breathing!
defeat: That's me running out of breath.
after: Onix down here soak up so much iron they turn to steel. Took me years to find this one.

name: Opal
intro: I came for the steel ore, not for company. But I'll take the battle.
after: Durant live in colonies down here. Where there's one, there are fifty.

name: Mora
intro: Hehehe... the dead of Sol don't like visitors. Neither do I.
defeat: Hehe... you have a strong aura...
after: Three sun dials sleep in these crypts. Wake them in the light, not the dark.

name: Tobin
intro: These tablets are older than Quarrytown! Don't touch! ...Battle me instead!
after: One of the dials in this wing is a fake. The builders loved a prank.

name: Sela
intro: I hear chimes in these crypts. They're calling for a battle!
after: Chingling love echoing halls. Ring a bell down here and it rings back forever.

name: Amon
intro: You opened the sun gate. Then you must face the sanctum's swords.
after: The Keeper waits beyond the stairs. She has guarded the altar since she was a girl.

name: Ilia
intro: The sun's guardians chose their trainers here long ago. Show me your light, and one may choose you.
defeat: Bright as noon. The altar is yours.
after: Raise the guardian well. Its ancestors kept the temple fires burning.

name: Harlan
intro: Every layer of this gulch is a different age! You're interrupting the Pleistocene!
after: Cubone wear the skulls of the past. Spooky? A little. Respectful? Very.

name: Wynn
intro: I climbed up here for the view. I'll battle for the exercise!
after: The ledges only go one way. Climb up the east path if you want to see the terrace again.

name: Rhea
intro: You found the terrace? Then you can find your way past me.
after: My Lycanroc evolved here at noon. Rockruff love the sunny cliffs.

name: Pia
intro: Perfect day for a picnic! And a battle, while the sandwiches cool.
defeat: I lost my appetite. Kidding! Sandwich?
after: Greedent stuffed a whole picnic in its cheeks once. I let it have the pickles.

name: Oren
intro: Throh throws, Sawk strikes. Together they are unstoppable!
after: I train behind the boulder where nobody bothers me. Well, almost nobody.

name: Moss
intro: Dig crew rules: no battles near the sieves. ...We're three steps away. Fair game!
after: Dr. Fenna can read a rock face like a book. Ask her about anything you dig up.

name: Rook
intro: Lineman on duty! Don't touch the pylons. Touch my Pokémon instead! In battle!
after: Team Eclipse spliced into our lines up here before the Voltara blackout. We're still finding their clamps.

name: Kip
intro: My dogs run on electricity! Literally! Wanna see?
after: Yamper chase the sparks off the power lines. They're never tired.

name: Vale
intro: Porygon was built from code. I'm upgrading it with battle data. Yours!
after: Porygon2 learns from every battle. I have to check it hasn't learned to unplug me.

name: Cyra
intro: My birds surf the static over the ridge! Catch the wind if you can!
after: Wattrel nest on the pylons. They store electricity in their throat pouches.

name: Marco
intro: I trained under Volta. Lightning doesn't strike twice. It strikes three times!
defeat: Grounded by a Spark Badge holder...
after: Volta told me to climb the ridge and think about losing. Now I've got more to think about.

name: Dina
intro: Plusle cheers, Minun cheers! Who's cheering for you?
defeat: Boo! ...No, wait, that was a good battle. Yay!
after: My sister Nell lives in the lineman's hut. She's been dying to trade for a Minun.

name: Bert
intro: The Guild started these tunnels and stopped halfway. I'm finishing them. After this battle.
after: There's a fossil pocket behind a cracked rock up north. I'd smash it, but I'm on break.

name: Quinn
intro: I revived these two from the gulch's lowest layer! Behold, the ancient seas!
after: Claw Fossils turn up in these tunnels. Root Fossils too, though I hear those come from hotter rock.

name: Soren
intro: Ground types rule the underground. Prove me wrong!
after: There's a boulder plugging the east tunnel. Strength will shift it.

name: Wynne
intro: I got lost looking for the picnic spot. Then I found Pokémon! Then I found you!
after: Tinkatuff carries a hammer bigger than its head. It made it out of scrap from these tunnels.

name: Rowe
intro: My magnetometer is going wild! Is it you? Is it a Nosepass? Battle and we'll find out!
defeat: It was a Nosepass. And also you.
after: Nosepass always point north. Handy if you get lost in a cave without a map.

name: Ione
intro: The catacombs are calling... Can you hear them? No? Then hear THIS!
after: The stairs down are in the southern ruins. Bring Flash. The dead of Sol hate visitors with torches. Kidding. Bring Flash.

name: Lia
intro: Sunbathing with my Pokémon! The ruins catch the best light!
after: Helioptile soak up sunlight and turn it into electricity. I'm trying to charge my phone with one.

name: Kestrel
intro: The Warden let you in too? Then you must be good. Prove it!
after: The lake in the next cavern drains east, into a grotto full of crystals. You'd need to Surf.

name: Orin
intro: I hear digging beneath this floor. Shovels. Voices. Do you hear them too?
after: There's an old ladder in this room. The digging sounds come from below it.

name: Grunt
intro: You got past the boulders? Ugh, I was promised this post would be boring!
after: Our real work's under the second floor. The admin doesn't want anybody to know. Oops.

name: Tess
intro: The crystals glow brighter underwater! Want to see? First, a battle!
after: The hermit on the central island collects glowing shards. He hums at them.

name: Kenji
intro: Nobody dives here but me! Well, me and now you. Let's battle for the record!
after: The lake is fed by snowmelt from the summit. Cold, clear, and full of Barboach.

name: Lorna
intro: Shh, you'll scare the Lumineon! ...Too late. Battle!
defeat: Lights out, like a Lumineon diving deep.
after: Lumineon's fins glow in the dark. In this grotto, everything glows.

name: Gemma
intro: Carbink and Minior are the prettiest gems in the grotto. Present company excluded!
after: Minior fall from the sky inside their shells. Some cracked open when they landed in here.

name: Flint
intro: Surfed in, did ya? I walked! Through a lot of very cold water. Battle!
after: Push the boulder at the south end of this gallery. There's a crystal chamber past it.

name: Pryce
intro: Prism crystals split light into seven colors! I've only counted six. Let's battle while I recount!
defeat: Seven! Seven colors and one defeat.
after: Team Eclipse wants this light. They'd drain the whole grotto if they found it.

name: Grunt
intro: How'd you find our dig?! This site is top secret!
defeat: Top secret, bottom of the barrel.
after: We're not stealing crystals here. We're stealing the HEART of the crystals. Totally different.

name: Grunt
intro: Lord Umbra's darkness needs light to devour. We dig it up, he eats it. Simple!
after: The scientist runs the siphon at the far end. He's... intense.

name: Grunt
intro: Hey! No kids in the pit! Hard hats only!
defeat: Should've worn a hard hat myself.
after: That cracked rock leads straight to the siphon. Smash it if you dare.

name: Grunt
intro: Ghosts love the dark down here. So do I. You? Not so much.
after: We caught a Carbink feeding on the crystal heart. The scientist keeps it caged to test the siphon.

name: Grunt
intro: Last guard before the siphon! I take this very seriously!
after: Don't bother the scientist. He bites. Figuratively. Mostly.

name: Nyle
intro: A child? In MY laboratory? The siphon is nearly calibrated. I won't have you jostling it!
after: Fine. Take the Carbink. The heart's light is already half drained. Lord Umbra will have his eclipse regardless.

name: Bryony
intro: Once upon a time, a trainer walked into Mistwood... and lost a battle! The end!
defeat: That's not how the story goes!
after: Clefairy dance around the moon pond at night. That part of the story is true.

name: Moth
intro: The fog is full of bug Pokémon! I'm catching them all! You're next! Wait, you're not a bug.
after: Ribombee roll pollen into little puffs. Fairies sell them in the market. Probably.

name: Vivi
intro: The mist does wonders for my complexion. And for my Sylveon's ribbons!
after: Eevee evolves into Sylveon when it loves you and knows a Fairy move. Romantic, isn't it?

name: Hale
intro: Ranger Hale, keeping travelers on the path. You're off the path! Battle!
defeat: You're on the path to victory, I guess.
after: The cut tree at the bottom of this trail is a shortcut back to the glade.

name: Wren
intro: The fog blinds the eyes, not the mind. I saw you coming three trees ago.
after: Something mimes in a hidden hollow in the north clearing. A cut tree hides the way.

name: Thistle
intro: Step into the fairy ring and you have to battle! Those are the rules! I made them up!
defeat: I'm making up a new rule: you win.
after: A little girl wandered past the ring earlier, crying for her mom. Poor thing.

name: Aurel
intro: I walk Mistwood every evening with my companions. Would you join us for a bout?
defeat: A splendid evening, all the same.
after: Lady Elowen trained in this very forest as a child. The fog taught her patience.

name: Lark
intro: Deep in the forest lives a trainer who never loses! ...That's me! Probably!
defeat: Okay, so it's a fairy tale.
after: Granny Moss lives by the old shrine. She knows every story in Mistwood.

name: Seren
intro: I'm preparing for Elowen's Gym. Fairy against Fairy! Ready to be my practice?
defeat: I needed that. The losing, I mean.
after: Elowen's Togekiss knows Aura Sphere. Bring something that can take it.

name: Alder
intro: I came for Venonat, but the webs here are HUGE! Something big lives here! Is it you?!
after: Galvantula spin electric webs between the trees. Watch your step in the dark.

name: Nima
intro: The fog muffles thoughts. Except yours. Yours are very loud.
after: Hattrem can sense emotions. It hides when people shout. So I whisper. Always.

name: Corin
intro: Old trees here have spirits in them. Trevenant protects the forest. So do I!
after: A tree on the east trail can be cut. It's an old shortcut to the shrine.

name: Lumi
intro: Flowers bloom brighter in the fog. Shall we see whose bloom is brightest?
after: Petilil turn into Lilligant with a Sun Stone. The Ruins of Sol have plenty of those.

name: Basil
intro: I bake for my Alcremie, and she bakes for me. Today's special: one battle, lightly whipped.
after: Alcremie's cream changes flavor with its mood. It's sweet today. You were kind to it.

name: Rowen
intro: Granny Moss trained Elowen. I want to be her next student. You're my entrance exam!
after: Granny says a fairy's strength is patience. I'm working on it. Impatiently.

name: Ines
intro: You found the ladder too? This is the deepest crystal gallery in Tessera!
after: Gible nest in these dark galleries, but I've only ever seen one.

name: Dunn
intro: Down here, the rock grows like trees! Crystals growing out of crystals! Battle!
after: These crystals are where Mt. Prism's glow comes from. Eclipse would love to know that.

name: Ash
intro: The crystals hum in a frequency only Psychic types hear. They're humming 'battle'.
after: The heart chamber in the middle is sealed by a boulder. Strength will open it.

name: Vey
intro: Ancient Pokémon swam here when this cave was a sea! I've brought two to prove it!
after: Relicanth hasn't changed in a hundred million years. It doesn't need to.

name: Lux
intro: My Rotom lives in my flashlight. It's brighter than Flash! Let's test it on you!
after: Rotom loves crawling into appliances. Last week it got into the lab fridge.

name: Teo
intro: The crystal heart chamber is mine! I've waited weeks for a worthy challenger!
after: Feel the warmth from the crystals? The mountain is alive. Eclipse wants to bleed it dry.

name: Gorm
intro: Came out the side tunnel, did you? Best view on Mt. Prism! And the best battles!
after: The ledges here drop you to the lower terrace. Walk up the west edge to climb back.

name: Ayla
intro: Rufflet love the updrafts on these slopes! Watch them soar, then watch them win!
after: Vullaby wear bones like diapers. Rufflet think that's hilarious. So do I.

name: Ryo
intro: Kicks! Punches! My brothers in arms! HYAH!
after: Tyrogue evolves depending on whether it's stronger in attack or defense. Mine chose both. Twice.

name: Mirela
intro: The upper terrace is for serious trainers only. Are you serious?
after: Axew are rare on these slopes. If you find one, train it. Haxorus is worth the wait.

name: Odo
intro: The summit's glow is fading. I can feel it. Can you feel this battle coming?
after: Seven colors of light, they say, one for each crystal heart. Something is drinking them.

name: Nan
intro: I rode Skiddo all the way up here! It's lunchtime, and battle time!
after: Skiddo can sense your feelings through its horns. Mine knows I'm a sore loser.

name: Bo
intro: Found a Bagon headbutting a cliff up here! Raised it myself! Wanna see what it can do?
after: Bagon dream of flying. Mine evolved and still can't. Someday, buddy. Someday.

name: Pyra
intro: The pass is warm enough to toast bread on! Want to see what else it toasts?
after: There's a cave up on the ridge. Hot air pours out of it day and night.

name: Dorian
intro: Blaise is three hours west and I'm still not ready. Help me get ready!
defeat: Okay, now I'm REALLY not ready.
after: Water and Ground for Blaise. Skarmory just for looking cool.

name: Tuck
intro: Ash in my boots, ash in my beard! Ash in my battle style!
after: The old lady by the spring has soaked there every day for fifty years. Ask her about it.

name: Saffi
intro: The spring steam is wonderful for scales and fur. Look how my Milotic shines!
defeat: Still shining. Just a little less.
after: Feebas evolve when their beauty peaks. Mine needed a Prism Scale and a lot of compliments.

name: Ignis
intro: The vents breathe fire! So do my Pokémon! Hah!
after: Slugma crawl right out of the vents. Their bodies are literally lava.

name: Gravel
intro: This chamber is warmer than my sauna back home! Battle until we sweat!
after: There's a little niche south of here behind a boulder. Strength will open it.

name: Vulk
intro: Fire Breathers train in the hollow before the Ashen Trail! FWOOOSH!
after: Master Kaen trains out west of Ashfall. If you beat his three students, he'll battle you himself.

name: Nadia
intro: Heat, darkness and a worthy opponent. Perfect training conditions!
after: Cracked rocks hide the east tunnel. Rock Smash through, and mind the ladder.

name: Caro
intro: I measure vent temperatures! Today's reading: way too hot for visitors!
after: Heatmor eat Durant, and Durant gang up on Heatmor. The hollow is a battlefield.

name: Fumo
intro: In the dark, a Fire Breather is a living torch! See me shine!
after: A hiker went down here yesterday and never came back up. I'd look in the south chamber.

name: Pyke
intro: Centiskorch coils at nine hundred degrees. Shall we see how hot you can take it?
after: Flash helps down here, but the magma glow is almost enough on its own.

name: Cinda
intro: Ghosts gather where fire burns... hehehe. They love the warmth. Like me.
after: Lampent drain the spirits of the lost. Don't get lost down here.

name: Cobb
intro: Deep rock, hot rock, good rock! Let's rumble!
after: The pocket in the middle of this floor is sealed by a boulder. Root fossils grow in hot rock like that.

name: Magna
intro: Magmar regulate their temperature like volcanoes. Fascinating! And dangerous! Battle!
after: Those Eclipse people tried to tap the vents for energy last month. Blaise ran them off.

name: Brand
intro: First of Master Kaen's three students! You'll have to go through my fire!
after: Two more students down the trail. Then the master himself, in the Obsidian Grotto.

name: Blaze
intro: Second student! I don't hold back on the basalt bridge!
after: Kaen trained Blaise of Ashfall once. She was his best. Now she runs the Gym.

name: Coal
intro: Third student, and the hottest! The ridge is mine!
after: Go on. The master's grotto is in the crater, north-west of here.

name: Veda
intro: Sand, ash and heat. Only the toughest Pokémon thrive out here. Mine thrive.
after: Sandaconda store sand in their coils. Mine sneezes it out when it's nervous.

name: Slag
intro: The crater's my favorite hiking spot! Steamy, rocky, perfect!
after: The hot spring in the crater has Pokémon in it. Surf if you dare. It's toasty.

name: Rosa
intro: Even the badlands bloom if you know where to look. Let me show you!
after: Cacnea bloom once a year, out here in the ash. It's beautiful, if you like prickles.

name: Kaen
intro: Three students fell before you. Now feel the fire they were taught!
defeat: Ha! Your fire burns hotter than mine, and that is the highest praise I know.
after: Blaise was my student once. Tell her old Kaen says hello, and that she still drops her guard on the left.

name: Flick
intro: A lava tube! The best place to practice breathing fire! Nothing to burn but you!
after: The tube climbs up to the caldera. The view from the rim is worth every step.

name: Morwen
intro: Chandelure's flames burn souls, not wood... hehehe. Shall it light yours?
after: A Dusk Stone turns Lampent into Chandelure. The Sol Catacombs had one, if you looked.

name: Hector
intro: Steel and poison, forged in volcanic heat! Ready to test your armor?
after: Aggron eat iron ore. In here, they practically live in a buffet.

name: Ferro
intro: Iron in the walls, iron in my Pokémon! Can you dent 'em?
after: Cracked rock down south opens a shortcut back to the entrance.

name: Inga
intro: My Rotom moved into a space heater! It's never been happier! Battle test!
after: Magmar evolve when traded holding a Magmarizer. There's one lying around up here somewhere.

name: Hob
intro: The caldera rim! Where the volcano breathes and so do I! FWOOSH!
after: Every Fire Breather climbs up here once. It's tradition. Also, the view.

name: Lyra
intro: I climbed the whole way to train before Blaise. Let's warm up together!
after: Blaise's Houndoom Mega Evolves. Hit it hard before it gets going.

name: Corvo
intro: The thermals over the crater are the strongest in Tessera! My birds love it!
after: They say a rainbow bird once circled this crater. Ember Tower was built facing it.

name: Teal
intro: Rangers patrol the rim for gas vents. And for trainers who need a battle!
after: Don't drink from the crater lake. It tastes like eggs. I learned the hard way.

name: Auri
intro: The crater focuses the mind. Or maybe that's the fumes. Battle!
after: The sage up here says the rainbow bird will return when the eclipse is broken. I believe him.

name: Garr
intro: Top of the volcano, top of my game! Bring it!
after: From up here you can see Ember Tower's roof. Nobody's been up there in a hundred years.

name: Mott
intro: Ledges everywhere! Once you jump down to the south rim there's no climbing back. Battle first!
after: Surf out to the little shrine in the lake. There's something shiny next to it.

name: Nalo
intro: Hot water, cold drinks and a battle! This is the life!
after: The pools stay warm all year. The volcano does the heating. Free!

name: Mina
intro: No splashing! ...Okay, a little splashing. In battle!
after: Slowbro love the hot pools. They doze off and forget to leave for days.

name: Oto
intro: I've soaked so long my fingers are prunes! Still battle-ready!
after: Step on the stones across the lower pool if you didn't bring a Surfer.

name: Horace
intro: A gentleman takes the waters, then takes on all challengers. In that order.
after: My Bewear hugs a little too hard after a bath. I'm told it means affection.

name: Coralie
intro: Steam is the secret to beautiful Pokémon. Let me show you the results!
after: The attendant here will rest your Pokémon for free. Such a dear.

name: Kiln
intro: The Vent Core! The hottest place in Tessera! The perfect place for my fire!
after: Magmortar fire flame cannons from their arms. Mine evolved from a Magmar I raised in this very vent.

name: Selene
intro: Only the strongest trainers find the Vent Core. Let's see if you belong here.
after: Blaise trains her Houndoom in this heat. That's why it never flinches at fire.

name: Ashlyn
intro: The vent spirits whisper... they say you'll lose... hehehe...
after: Ghosts and fire get along wonderfully. They both like to haunt dark places.

name: Tinder
intro: The deepest vent is mine! I've been stoking it for a week!
after: Centiskorch curl up in the vents to stay warm. I've been trying the same thing.

name: Cinda
intro: Ashfall's ash is still in my hair. My Pokémon say it suits me!
after: Torkoal puff smoke when they're happy. Mine never stops.

name: Bert
intro: Look how fluffy they are! Okay, now look how strong they are!
after: I comb Wigglytuff every night. It takes an hour. Worth it.

name: Selene
intro: The cavern's crystals made my team shine brighter. Let me show you!
after: Quartz says a Tera Type can turn a weakness into a strength. Think about that before Frostmere.

name: Garn
intro: This is MY crystal vein! Well, I found it first. Probably.
after: Sudowoodo isn't a tree. Don't tell it I said that.

name: Beryl
intro: My instruments say your team is about to lose! My instruments are often wrong.
after: Klinklang's gears hum at the same pitch as the Tera crystals. Coincidence? Yes, probably.

name: Marlo
intro: I swim the bay twice a day! Want to race? No? Battle, then!
after: There's a cave in the cliff of the southwest islet. Divers say a ship's down there.

name: Ondine
intro: The current here is perfect for training. And for battling you!
after: Araquanid carry a bubble of water everywhere. Like a tiny aquarium!

name: Gus
intro: Shh! The fish here are smarter than me. You, too, maybe. Battle!
after: The Halcyon sank in a storm when the sky went black at noon. My dad saw it.

name: Wade
intro: A whole cave lake and nobody fishing it! Except me. And now you.
after: Bruxish grind their teeth so loud the whole grotto echoes.

name: Reef
intro: Careful, the water down here stings. So do my Pokémon!
after: Toxapex sit on the rocks like little crowns. Don't touch them.

name: Lagoon
intro: It's so quiet in here. Let's make some noise!
after: Swim out to the little islets. People drop things there.

name: Coralie
intro: This grotto is a nursery for reef Pokémon. Prove you'll respect it!
after: Golisopod guard the wreck's deck like knights. Very grumpy knights.

name: Mireille
intro: The crew still walks these halls... Can you hear their footsteps? They're angry.
after: The captain's ghost isn't here. He's still alive, you know. He just left his heart on this ship.

name: Brack
intro: Treasure! Gold! Doubloons! ...Or at least a battle!
after: The good loot sank into the hold. It's flooded and pitch black down there.

name: Quill
intro: I served on the Halcyon's sister ship. Show some respect, landlubber!
after: Captain Morrel was the best skipper on the coast. He lives in the Sea Cottage now.

name: Aldous
intro: I collect maritime antiques. You are standing on one. Shall we duel?
after: The captain's log would fetch a fortune. Yet it belongs with the captain, wouldn't you say?

name: Finn
intro: Diving in a dark wreck is the best training! You can't see what's coming!
defeat: I didn't see that coming either.
after: Carracosta lived in shipwrecks long before people built ships. Think about that.

name: Tamsin
intro: The hold's water is full of strange energy. My Rotom loves it!
after: The energy comes from the anchor. Or from what's living in it.

name: Nerissa
intro: Dark, damp and full of ghosts. Exactly my kind of evening!
after: Big Pearls wash up in here. The sea gives back what it takes.

name: Sigrid
intro: Isolde sent me to scout for students! Let's see if you're worth reporting!
after: The ice field has a pattern. Rocks are your friends, walls are your friends. Gaps are not.

name: Lars
intro: Cave boarding! It's like snowboarding, except with more walls!
after: Crabominable climbed all the way up here from the coast. Respect the climb.

name: Tove
intro: Made it across the ice! My legs are jelly but my team is fresh!
after: The ladder goes down to the frozen lake. I'm resting here a while.

name: Astrid
intro: I'm Isolde's top student. Beat me and you might stand a chance against her!
after: Isolde's Lapras can Gigantamax. Its G-Max Resonance sets up Aurora Veil. Break it fast!

name: Aurora
intro: The Power Spot hums through the ice... I've been listening for days.
defeat: The humming stopped. Oh, it's just my ears ringing.
after: Galar particles pool deepest in the den below. Something big sleeps there.

name: Soren
intro: You crossed the frozen lake? Took me a week! Battle!
after: The den ladder is just past me. Bring something that can handle a Gigantamax body slam.

name: Marlstone
intro: Every colour of crystal, all in one cave! I could live here. I might already live here.
after: Somebody's been prying open Quartz's sample crates. Wasn't me. I only lick the crystals.

name: Iolite
intro: Each crystal sings a different note. Yours is off-key. Allow me to tune it!
after: A Pokémon's Tera Type is like a hidden note. You only hear it when it shines.

name: Jasper
intro: I came down here to Terastallize in peace. You'll do as a test!
after: There's a guy in black at the far end hauling a sack. I figured he was a very serious hiker.

name: Opaline
intro: I only wear crystals I find myself. Battle me and I'll show you my favourites!
after: Tinkaton smash crystals with their hammers. Mine is very gentle. Mostly.

name: Grunt Dorran
intro: Retreat? Nobody told ME to retreat! These shards are going to Prism Summit, and so am I. Eventually.
defeat: Okay, okay! Take the sack! It was giving me a backache anyway.
after: Umbra won't even notice I'm late. Right? ...Right?

name: Kelp
intro: I'm mapping the grotto by swimming every inch of it! You're on my map now!
after: The lake is deepest under the wreck. Lanturn light it up at night like lanterns.

name: Bosun
intro: I was a deckhand on the Halcyon, back in the day! I still come to keep her company.
defeat: Ship's bell rings for you, matey.
after: The captain lives at the Sea Cottage. Never talks about the Dark Noon. Maybe you can get him to.

name: Britt
intro: The ridge run is the best slope in Tessera! Battle first, slope later!
defeat: Off-piste and out of the race!
after: The frozen waterfall only thaws for trainers with the Frost Badge. That's what the locals say, anyway.

name: Ike
intro: Ice fishing! You cut a hole, you wait, you freeze. Then you battle passers-by.
after: Walrein come up through the ice holes to breathe. Gave me the fright of my life.

name: Dane
intro: Seven badges? I'm on my way to Ryuga too. Let's see who's readier!
after: Ryuga's dragons can all Terastallize into Dragon type. Pack Ice, Fairy and Dragon moves.

name: Runa
intro: Hiked up here with my whole team in my backpack. My back hurts. Battle!
after: Above the frozen falls there's a cave full of ice. Even hikers turn around there.

name: Cyra
intro: My birds ride the updrafts off the ridge! Watch them dive!
after: Dragons nest on the Roost above Dragonspire. My birds won't fly within a mile of it.

name: Maren
intro: Indoor ice! No wind, no snow, just a perfect slide. And a battle!
after: Slide across the ice for the stone in the middle. Rocks will stop you; nothing else will.

name: Tarn
intro: Swimming in a frozen cave lake keeps you young! I'm actually ninety!
defeat: Okay, I'm thirty. But I feel ninety now.
after: The waterfall at the north end climbs to an upper gallery. There's a ledge to get back down.

name: Ulla
intro: The ice here is thousands of years old! So are my jokes. Battle!
after: Icy Rock makes hail last longer. Isolde swears by it.

name: Kiri
intro: Frigibax hatch in this cave. Keep it down and battle me quietly!
after: Baxcalibur hold their breath underwater for an hour. Their dorsal blade cuts through ice like paper.

name: Halvard
intro: Climbed a waterfall to get here, didn't you? So did I. Let's see whose climb was worth it.
after: I train up here before every League attempt. This year might be the year. Maybe.

name: Vey
intro: The Roost Trail is for Clan pilgrims! Are you a pilgrim? Prove it!
after: The hermit at the top taught Elder Draca everything she knows. And he never lets her forget it.

name: Osric
intro: Fog this thick means the dragons are flying. Better battle before they land on us!
after: Noivern can see through fog with their ears. Echolocation! Mine can't, but it tries.

name: Maeve
intro: Halfway up and I'm out of breath. Not out of fight, though!
after: Rest at the Dragonspire Center before the summit. The hermit doesn't do refreshments.

name: Brann
intro: I carry firewood up to the hermit every week. Today I carry a battle!
after: The hermit's apprentice eats all the snacks I bring. Don't tell him I said that.

name: Isha
intro: My Druddigon has climbed this trail a hundred times. You're new. Let's fix that.
after: Draco Meteor is the Clan's secret technique. Only the hermit teaches it.

name: Cort
intro: I've climbed to the Roost every spring for forty years. Never missed one. Never lost here, either.
after: The year of the Dark Noon, the dragons on the Roost wouldn't stop roaring. I was a boy. I remember.

name: Nim
intro: The air thins, the mind sharpens. Yours is about to be sharpened against mine.
defeat: My mind... is a blunt instrument.
after: The Sky Tablet on the summit hums when the wind blows. I think it's trying to say something.

name: Rhea
intro: You climbed the whole trail? The hermit might actually talk to you. Battle me first!
after: Don't stare at the hermit's eyebrows. He's sensitive about them.

name: Corwin
intro: I came for the hermit's blessing and stayed for the view. And the battles!
defeat: The view's still nice, at least.
after: The founders kept their dragons up here. The statues are older than the city.

name: Sorin
intro: Draca sent you? Then let us see whether she has finally learned to judge character.
after: Draco Meteor spends a dragon's strength in one blow. Use it wisely, and only when it matters.

name: Selka
intro: The Clan asked trainers to watch the pass. I'm watching. Now I'm battling!
after: Haru the scout saw grunts carrying crates into a cave in the west cliff. A second lens, maybe?

name: Oskar
intro: The pass is no place for sightseeing! Unless you can battle. Can you?
after: Eclipse grunts have been using the pass like a highway. Rude highway, too. No waving.

name: Grunt
intro: Whoa, whoa! This is a restricted workshop! Do you have a hard hat? No? Battle!
after: We grind lenses here. The big one's already on the summit. The spare's in the back.

name: Grunt
intro: I've been polishing glass for three weeks. I NEED a battle!
after: The gates to the lab open from the side rooms. Don't tell anyone I told you. I'm bored.

name: Lumen
intro: Light is just energy waiting to be redirected. Your Pokémon, too!
after: A lens doesn't create light, it focuses it. Umbra's focuses darkness. Mostly.

name: Grunt
intro: This switch is MINE. I'm guarding it with my life! Or at least my lunch break!
after: Fine, flip the switch. I'm going to go eat.

name: Obscura
intro: Intruder! The Lens Division will not be disrupted by a child with a Badge Case!
defeat: Disrupted by a child with a Badge Case...
after: Without the backup lens, Umbra has only one chance at the summit. One is all he needs. I hope.

name: Grunt
intro: The chief said nobody gets near the lens. You're somebody, so... battle!
after: The chief designed both lenses. He's very proud. And very bad at losing.

name: Grunt
intro: You made it past the gates? The chief's gonna blame ME for this!
after: Lens number three? Doesn't exist. Budget cuts.

name: Chief Halloran
intro: My beautiful lens! Do you know how long it takes to grind obsidian to a perfect curve? You will not touch it!
defeat: Three years of work... undone by a child.
after: Go ahead, then. Umbra has the first lens. One is all he needs.

name: Kale
intro: You found the secret ladder! Now find out why nobody comes back up smiling!
after: The ice field down there has one clean line through it. I've never found it. I just bounce.

name: Ingrid
intro: You crossed the ice? Then you're worthy of the dragon's treasure. Almost. Battle me!
after: Legend says a Clan founder carved that ice dragon. Legend also says it moves at night. Legend says a lot.

name: Wren
intro: Up here the wind does half the work! My birds just steer!
after: On a clear day you can see Prism Summit from here. Lately it's always dark over there.

name: Aldric
intro: I tend the founders' statues. Show me the respect you'd show them!
after: The statues face Mt. Prism. The founders wanted to keep watch on what sleeps there.

name: Haldor
intro: I punch icicles to train! Today I punch... well, I battle you!
after: Never punch the ice dragon in the depths. I tried. It didn't move. My hand did.

name: Orla
intro: Eight badges and a road to the League. Same as you! Let's find out who goes first.
after: Victory Road has a ladder down on the second floor. The trainers down there are... something else.

name: Bastian
intro: I swim the Skyfall every day. Cold enough to wake the dead! Or at least me.
after: The river comes out of a cave at its north end. Swim up past the bridge if you're brave.

name: Petra
intro: Before the League, a warm-up! For me, I mean. You're my warm-up.
after: Some Eclipse grunts didn't get the memo that it's over. One's camping on the lake islet.

name: Maris
intro: You swam into the grotto? Me too! Let's celebrate with a battle!
after: Climb the inner waterfall and you'll come out in a valley nobody knows about. Well, nobody except me.

name: Tobin
intro: Secret fishing spot! Well, it was secret. Now you know. Battle me to forget!
defeat: I'll never forget this loss, though.
after: Barraskewda bite anything shiny. Including fishing lures. Including my watch.

name: Reza
intro: This is my last training stop before the League. Make it count!
after: Morrow's Gengar knows a Z-Move. Save a Normal or Dark type to take it.

name: Ilse
intro: I lost to the Elite Four nine times. Battle me, and I'll tell you how not to make it ten.
defeat: Well. You won't need my advice.
